### DEBT [consistency]: src/domains/release/release-notes.ts:65-67
Reference: Horizontal consistency rule — a new code path re-derives a value an existing function already derives; if the two derivations disagree on any documented input, the reviewer surfaces the disagreement.
Evidence: `src/domains/audit/paths.ts:28` checks `rel.startsWith("..")`. The new derivation in `release-notes.ts` checks `relativeToWorkingTree === ".." || relativeToWorkingTree.startsWith("../") || isAbsolute(relativeToWorkingTree)`. For a valid configured path whose relative form begins with `".."` but is not a parent traversal — e.g., a directory literally named `"..foo"` so that `relative(workingDirectory, resolved)` = `"..foo/CHANGELOG.md"` — `paths.ts` incorrectly rejects it (`.startsWith("..")` = true) while `release-notes.ts` correctly allows it (neither equals `".."` nor starts with `"../"`). Two path-containment derivations in the same codebase disagree.
Required: Extract a shared helper (e.g., `isPathContained(root: string, candidate: string): boolean`) using the precise `=== ".." || startsWith("../") || isAbsolute` form, and replace both `paths.ts:28` and `release-notes.ts:65-67` call sites with it.

### DEBT [evidence]: spx/26-release.enabler/32-release-notes.enabler/tests/release-notes.conformance.l1.test.ts
Reference: Spec assertion: "Generated release notes conform to the Keep a Changelog structure ([test])". `assertConformsToKeepAChangelog` has two independent throwing branches: (1) `!notes.includes(CHANGELOG_TITLE)` and (2) `!notes.includes(versionHeading)`. Both must be exercised to provide evidence for the conformance assertion.
Evidence: The rejection test draws one value from `fc.constantFrom(missingTitle, missingVersionSection, EMPTY_CHANGELOG)` via `sampleReleaseTestValue` (fixed seed `0x5e5530`). The seed deterministically picks one of the three; `missingTitle` and `EMPTY_CHANGELOG` both trigger branch (1) only; `missingVersionSection` triggers branch (2) only. Whichever the seed selects, the other validator branch is never exercised. If the seed picks either of the branch-(1) cases, the `!notes.includes(versionHeading)` path in the validator is entirely unverified by any test.
Required: Replace the single `sampleReleaseTestValue` draw with three explicit `it` blocks (or `test.each`), one per non-conformant case (`missingTitle`, `missingVersionSection`, `EMPTY_CHANGELOG`), so both validator branches are covered on every run.

### FOLLOW-UP [standards]: CLAUDE.md
Reference: CLAUDE.md "## Architecture" section documents the `src/` tree as the canonical orientation guide agents and contributors consult. The ADR `21-release-notes-generation.adr.md` mandates the `AgentRunner` interface live in `src/agent/` as a distinct infrastructure layer alongside `src/git/`.
Issue: `src/agent/` is introduced as a new top-level module by this PR but does not appear in the CLAUDE.md architecture diagram, leaving it invisible to agents and contributors reading that section for orientation.
Track under: spx/26-release.enabler/32-release-notes.enabler/ISSUES.md
